Subject: CRM: Forecast data cleanup & handoff to Finance

Team,

Finance asked us to run a short, targeted cleanup of the Q2 committed pipeline for Acme Health before the Friday commit review. The goal is to make the forecast usable for revenue recognition planning and to avoid last-minute surprises. High-level asks: 

- Confirm deal amount (list currency and precise ARR/one-time breakdown)
- Standardize Product/SKU mapping (use the SKU column in the template)
- Update "Next step" to a single next action with owner and date
- Set a realistic probability (commit vs. best-case) and stage (Proposal / Contract / Legal)
- Add any outstanding gating items (security, procurement, signatures)

I attached a small CSV template (forecast-cleanup-template.csv) — please populate only the rows for ACME and related line-items. Quick timeline: please update HubSpot by EOD Thursday (2026-05-14) and confirm in this thread. Finance will do a final pass on Friday morning.

HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/1234567890
Google sheet (read-only for reference): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcD-forecast-template

Thanks — keep it focused, we only need clean fields for the commit.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Lauren — quick question on SKUs: Acme has three line items in HubSpot right now (Core API, Dedicated Pool, Optimize). Do you want us to: 

1) collapse to a single "Platform - ACME" line with total ARR and list SKUs in the notes, or
2) keep separate line items so Finance sees product-level revenue?

My preference is (2) to avoid rolling back later, but if Finance wants a single commit number we can add a parent-level combined row. Also, are we aligning currency to USD (customer billing in USD) or keeping local?

—Marcus

Lauren
